subject: Scoutly pilot: alignment & next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Foster <alex@scoutly.com>, Priya Shah <priya@scoutly.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Scoutly pilot: alignment & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our discovery + proposed pilot plan so we have a single source of truth and clear next steps. Please reply with any corrections or confirm and we’ll calendar the kickoff.

Key pain points you shared
- Search relevance for top-of-funnel candidate matching is drifting as new profiles are added (precision drop ~12% last quarter).
- Query latency spikes during batch enrichment jobs (affects UX for hiring managers).
- Cost per inference is unpredictable for certain long-sequence ranking operations.

Desired outcomes for pilot (30-day sprint)
- Improve top-10 relevance by +8–12% on Scoutly’s eval set (we’ll use your labeled sampling).
- Maintain 95th percentile latency under 220ms for interactive flows during normal traffic.
- Demonstrate a >20% reduction in per-request cost for the targeted ranking pipeline using batching + quantized model variant.

Proposed pilot scope (what Redwood will deliver)
- Baseline eval: run your 2k prompt evaluation suite against three candidate model variants and report token-level cost + latency.
- Integration: lightweight inference adaptor for your ranking service (API + Docker sidecar or direct API call depending on your infra).
- Ops: monitoring dashboard, tokenized cost breakdown, and simple fallback policy (smaller model) if capacity constrained.
- Rollover test: A/B traffic split (10/90) during week 3 for live validation.

Success metrics
- Relevance uplift on eval set (primary)
- 95th pctl latency under 220ms (SLO)
- Unit cost reduction % (target >20%)

Immediate asks from Scoutly
- Access: API key for a staging instance (or a short-lived VM image) + a sample of 500 labeled queries and a small production-like dataset (S3 or CSV).
- Security: point of contact for SOC2 questionnaire and any network requirements (IP allowlist / SAML).
- Stakeholders: confirm two product owners who will own acceptance criteria and deployment sign-off.

Owners (Redwood)
- Rishi: overall PM / pilot lead
- Monica: onboarding & infra integration
- Neha: eval design and metrics

Attachments: scoutly-pilot-scope.xlsx (pilot scope + timeline), access-checklist.md (what we need to start)

Proposed next steps / calendar
- Confirm scope + security contact by Tue 11/17
- Pilot kickoff (remote): week of Mon 11/22 — we have availability 11/22 or 11/24 (30–60m)
- Deliver baseline eval by 11/29; week 3 A/B test 11/29–12/6

If that looks good, I’ll send calendar invitations and a short kickoff agenda. Thanks again — excited to get started.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

We can confirm final acceptance criteria after the baseline eval, but the three success metrics you listed sound right. Please go ahead and send the invite for 11/22 at 10:00am PT.
